fixture.description: Each source card references a different entry in one redirect chain ending in an active registry ID.

measurement: Count project.registry.byId.get calls through CountingMap during validateProject. Input setup and filesystem scanning are excluded. These are lookup counts, not wall-time or heap measurements.

before.regression: The new linear-lookup budget fails against the baseline implementation.

complexity.notation: R relations, V registry IDs, E redirect and replacement edges
complexity.stateResolutionAfter: O(V + E + R) per validation pass
complexity.additionalCacheSpace: O(V + E), storing states rather than full resolution chains
complexity.scope: Registry state analysis only; other validation work and diagnostic sorting are unchanged.

compatibility.cacheLifetime: One synchronous validateProject call; the next call creates a fresh resolver.
